OpenVDB: DDA< RayT, Log2Dim > Class Template Reference
Note Conceptually similar to Bresenham's line algorithm applied to a 3D Ray intersecting OpenVDB nodes or voxels. Log2Dim = 0 corresponds to a voxel and Log2Dim a tree node of size 2^Log2Dim. The Ray template class is expected to have the following methods: test (time), t0 (), t1 (), invDir (), and operator () (time).
